# context-inbox

> A framework for turning messages from any source into cited changes in any destination. An agent drafts each change, a person approves it on a claude.ai review page, and the next run writes only approved changes.

Each project keeps a folder in a separate private repo with `config.json` and `RULES.md`. The config maps channels to destinations and names a reader per source and a guide per destination.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): setup, reader and guide formats, and the daily run.
- [RULES.md](RULES.md): what a proposal is, how to write it, and its JSON shape.
- [connector/check.py](connector/check.py): checks a projects repo and prints each reader command and guide path.

## Integrations

- [integrations/slack/reader.py](integrations/slack/reader.py): Slack reader, thread replies included.
- [integrations/linear/guide.md](integrations/linear/guide.md): Linear issues and comments.
- [integrations/attio/guide.md](integrations/attio/guide.md): Attio deal notes and tasks.
- [integrations/github/guide.md](integrations/github/guide.md): one commit per item to a repo.
- [integrations/recipes/](integrations/recipes/): Slack to Linear, Slack to Attio, Slack to GitHub.

## Run

- [runner/prompt.txt](runner/prompt.txt): prompt for a scheduled run.
- [runner/fire.sh](runner/fire.sh): start the scheduled cloud run from any agent or script.
- [runner/run.sh](runner/run.sh): run once on this machine, in an interactive session.
- [.claude/skills/](.claude/skills/): setup and run-now skills.
- [.claude/hooks/require-ctx-marker.py](.claude/hooks/require-ctx-marker.py): refuses destination writes that lack a `ctx:` marker, and chat posts.

## Optional

- [projects-example/](projects-example/): a projects repo with one project.
- [ui/review.html](ui/review.html): the review page and run log.
- [README.md](README.md): overview and manual setup for people.
